ideas.pitch: A predictive risk modeling dashboard designed to forecast cloud infrastructure failures using Poisson GAMs and rolling backtests.
ideas.title: ScaleMetrics AI Incident Forecaster
ideas.why_it_could_win: Adopts the rigorous predictive modeling and statistical validation approach of the Apart Research AI Forecasting Hackathon winner, appealing to technical judges looking for mathematical depth.

ideas.pitch: An end-to-end mobile workflow utilizing low-latency device features to onboard users and check eligibility for decentralized networks.
ideas.title: BaseOnboard iOS
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly targets the commercializability criteria seen in the Base X AITX Talent Hackathon winner by providing a polished, ready-to-deploy mobile user experience.

ideas.pitch: An automated financial crime detection engine combining graph intelligence and gradient boosting models for explainable risk scoring.
ideas.title: GraphAML Investigator
ideas.why_it_could_win: Mimics the architecture of the DIGITIMES AI Innovation Hackathon winner by focusing on enterprise-grade explainability and high-stakes risk investigation.

ideas.pitch: A computer vision platform utilizing pose estimation to analyze human movement kinetics and generate real-time feedback with confidence gating.
ideas.title: AeroPose Biomechanical Analyst
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages the proven winning formula of the NeuroForge Hackathon by combining robust MediaPipe pose detection with a working, interactive live demo.

ideas.pitch: An AI-powered satellite imagery monitoring tool that automatically flags industrial land and zoning compliance violations.
ideas.title: GeoCompliance ATLAS
ideas.why_it_could_win: Replicates the practical civic utility and geospatial focus of the Xcelerate Hackathon runner-up, solving a real monitoring challenge for regulatory bodies.
